usedFor: Each Calendly booking becomes a Trello card for meeting prep.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Create Trello Card” in Trello
bestTemplate.why: It makes one card per new booking, and its hook delivery beats the polling option.

watchOut: “When a meeting is scheduled, rescheduled, or canceled” covers several states, so one meeting can make several cards.
